text:
Maya K: hi team — I accepted the org invite but can't see the repo infra/ci-config or the Actions tab. It says "You don’t have access". I need to edit the CI pipelines for my first-week task.

Ben L: welcome! do you see the org in https://github.com/redwood-inference when you click your profile -> organizations?

Maya K: yes I see Redwood Inference in my org list. clicking the repo link gives 404.

Ben L: 404 usually means you're not a member of the team with repo access. did you accept via the email invite or via SSO?

Maya K: accepted via the email invite link. we had SSO enforced, but I already logged in with SSO after accepting.

Jamie P: hey @Maya K — people-ops provisioned invites earlier but sometimes team membership sync lags. I can trigger a reprovision. which teams did the onboarding form list?

Maya K: infra, ci-owners.

onboarding-bot: new-hire provisioning: queued team sync for user maya.k (job id: 64721).

Ben L: try running `gh auth status` and then `gh api /user/memberships/orgs/redwood-inference` to confirm membership locally. sometimes github.com needs you to sign out then back in after SSO.

Maya K: ran `gh auth status` — shows logged in via web auth. `gh api` returns 404 for /memberships endpoint.

Alex S: i think the invite landed as outside collaborator instead of org member. that would give org visibility but not repo membership. @people-ops can fix but i can also add you to the repo directly if needed.

Jamie P: confirmed — provisioning created an outside_collaborator role by mistake for a handful of new-hires. I'm updating the provisioning script now and will convert Maya to a full member.

Maya K: thank you! any ETA? I have a PR to update ci pipelines this afternoon.

Jamie P: converting now, may take 2–3 minutes to propagate. after conversion, if Actions still blocked it might be repo-level policies.

Ben L: heads up — infra/ci-config restricts workflow run permissions to org owners and approved runners. if you need to run workflows for testing i'll temporarily add your user to the allowed list.

Alex S: done — added maya.k as allowed actor for workflows and added to infra-team. should be visible now.

Maya K: I can see the repo and Actions tab now :tada: I can open the CI workflow file and create a branch. thanks everyone!

Ben L: nice. when you run into a permission error again ping #new-hires or @onboarding-bot. we'll update the provisioning ticket to avoid this class of bug.

Jamie P: Filed ticket: ONBOARD-1123 — fix outside_collaborator provisioning for SSO-enabled invites. assigned to people-ops.

Maya K: awesome, appreciate the quick help. one small ask — could someone add a note to the onboarding checklist about signing out/in after SSO invite? saved me debugging time.

Jamie P: added to checklist. :white_check_mark:
